Antique Amber Glass Bottle Collection – 6 Pieces
$35 - 81521

Beautiful collection of 6 vintage amber/brown glass bottles in a variety of sizes and shapes. These have wonderful old-fashioned character, including pharmaceutical/apothecary-style bottles and a large embossed bottle.

The rich amber glass and natural variations make these perfect for antique or vintage décor, farmhouse displays, apothecary collections, shelf styling, dried flowers, or photography props.

All are being sold together as a collection. Vintage condition with age-related wear; please see photos for condition.

💰 Asking $35 for the set

Great statement pieces with lots of character—perfect for anyone who loves antique glass or rustic farmhouse décor.

Vintage Antique Wood Screen Door – Farmhouse / Rustic – $100 OBO
$100 - 81521

Beautiful vintage wooden screen door with lots of original character and a naturally weathered green finish. Solid, tall wood frame with multiple panel sections and screening.

Great piece for:

* Historic home restoration
* Farmhouse or cabin
* Porch or patio
* Garden entrance
* Rustic decor or architectural salvage project

Shows age, wear, paint loss and patina consistent with an older door, which adds to its character. Could be used as-is for a rustic look or restored/refinished.

$100 OBO

Buyer pickup in Fruita.

H 85 1/4
W 32 5/8
Can be cut down up to four inches on height and 2 inches on width.

Craftsman Professional 17” Floor Drill Press – Heavy Duty – $450 OBO
$450 - 81501

Craftsman Professional 17-inch heavy-duty floor-standing drill press with Laser-Trac. Large, solid machine that’s great for a garage, fabrication shop, woodworking shop, or home workshop.

Specifications:

* 17” floor model
* 3/4 HP continuous-duty induction motor
* 120/240V
* Single phase
* 1,725 RPM motor
* Laser-Trac system
* Adjustable cast-iron work table
* Heavy-duty floor-standing design
* Model #152.229010

Used condition with normal cosmetic wear and some surface rust on the table from storage. Very solid, well-built older Craftsman Professional machine.

$450 OBO
